Grizzlies 114Timberwolves 109

Coward's 22 wins Memphis its Cup group

Final · Fri, Nov 27 · Minnesota

Memphis beat Minnesota 114–109, a 5-point road win. The Grizzlies move to 15–5; the Timberwolves fall to 14–6.
